The Future of EV Charging in Los Angeles: New Technologies, Solar Integration, and Incentives for Property Owners

Introduction

The electric vehicle (EV) market is experiencing rapid growth in Los Angeles and across the United States. With more drivers making the switch to electric vehicles, businesses, homeowners, and property managers are considering how to meet growing demands for EV charging. At Shaffer Construction, Inc., we specialize in designing and installing EV charger infrastructure that’s reliable, future-focused, and tailored to the unique needs of our clients.

This article explores the latest advances in EV charging technology, details about solar-integrated charging, key market trends, and the opportunities for commercial property owners and businesses in the Los Angeles region.

A Surge in EV Adoption and Charging Infrastructure Demand

As governments and industries push for electrification, EV sales are rising sharply. According to recent market research, the global EV charging station market is projected to reach $137.4 billion by 2030, reflecting significant investment and interest in sustainable transportation infrastructure. California, with strong state incentives and emissions targets, leads the nation in both EV adoption and charging station installations.

This accelerating shift is motivating commercial property owners, multi-family building managers, and businesses to incorporate EV charging solutions as essential amenities. Future-proofing your building or property by installing EV charging infrastructure can:

Attract new tenants, customers, and employees

Increase property value

Support sustainability and ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) goals

Qualify for rebates and incentives

New Charging Technology: Faster and Smarter Solutions Arrive

Modern charging technology is advancing rapidly, making EV ownership more convenient than ever. One of the most remarkable milestones was recently demonstrated by BYD in China: a five-minute fast charging session using megawatt-level charging technology. While these ultra-fast solutions are currently being piloted in China, they set the stage for next-generation commercial charging sites in the U.S.

In the U.S., the move toward faster, higher-output Level 3 DC Fast Chargers and smarter networked charging solutions is well under way. These chargers can deliver a full vehicle charge in 30-60 minutes, making them ideal for fleet operations, businesses with high vehicle turnover, or locations along major travel corridors.

Key innovations featured in new charging systems include:

Intelligent energy management and scheduling

Built-in diagnostics and maintenance indicators

Remote monitoring and mobile app integration

Integration with payment and access control systems

These features not only improve reliability but also enable owners to better manage operational costs and ensure availability for drivers.

Solar-Powered EV Charging: The Next Leap in Sustainable Mobility

Los Angeles enjoys abundant sunlight, making solar-powered EV charging an increasingly attractive option for businesses and commercial properties. SolarEdge Technologies, a leader in renewable energy solutions, recently launched a solar-powered EV charging solution designed specifically for business, multi-family, and fleet settings. These systems not only provide emission-free charging, but can also reduce operating expenses by utilizing on-site renewable energy.

Advantages of solar-integrated EV chargers include:

Lower electricity costs by offsetting grid power with solar

Reduced carbon footprint, supporting sustainability certifications

Eligibility for combined solar and EV charging incentives

Increased energy resilience and the potential for backup power

For example, the new SolarEdge 22 kW solar-integrated charger offers powerful charging for commercial and industrial clients, with plans to expand to residential solutions in the near future. Pairing solar with EV charging is a compelling way for property owners in sun-rich regions like Southern California to further reduce operational costs and differentiate their buildings.

Maintenance and Support: Keeping Chargers Running Smoothly

With more critical infrastructure like EV chargers deployed, businesses and property managers need to ensure continuous uptime and reliability. Regular maintenance and proactive service plans are now available in the industry, designed to minimize downtime and optimize equipment lifespan.

Recently, expanded service networks such as those offered by InCharge Energy show the importance of ongoing diagnostics, repairs, and expert support. Proper maintenance for EV charging stations includes:

Frequent inspections for cable and connector wear

Software updates and network monitoring

Electrical safety and power system checks

Prompt repair of damaged or defective equipment

At Shaffer Construction, we offer installation, consultation, and can guide you in organizing reliable maintenance for your EV charging assets—protecting your investment and ensuring a positive experience for users.

Tailoring EV Charging Solutions for Every Client

No two projects are identical. At Shaffer Construction, Inc., we approach each EV charging installation with a focus on your specific goals. Whether you need a few smart chargers for your business, want to install a fast-charging plaza for a multi-tenant property, or are looking to integrate solar power, we help you:

Assess electrical capacity and site requirements

Choose the right mix of Level 2 and DC fast charging stations

Secure permits and manage utility coordination

Maximize available California incentives and rebates

Ensure future scalability as your needs grow

For commercial and multifamily properties, we also assist with back-end solutions—such as access controls (key cards or mobile apps), billing systems, and integration with building management platforms. We understand that EV charging is not only about utility, but also about creating an excellent experience for everyone using your property.

Rebates, Incentives, and Regulatory Trends in California

Capitalizing on various rebates and incentives can significantly lower your up-front costs for EV charging equipment and installation. Los Angeles and California offer some of the country’s most generous support programs, including:

California Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Project (CALeVIP)

LADWP and SCE (Southern California Edison) commercial charging rebates

Federal tax credits for alternative fueling infrastructure

Utility “make-ready” programs that fund necessary electrical upgrades

As adoption climbs and regulations continue to expand—especially with new building codes favoring clean technology installations—this is an ideal time to plan for and implement EV charging at your property.

The Future: High-Speed and Scalable Charging Networks

Ultra-fast charging, fleet-focused energy management, and solar integration represent the next stage of the EV revolution. Technologies being developed today, such as the recently demoed BYD megawatt charger, point to a future where “refuelling” an EV is as fast and seamless as filling up a traditional vehicle.

Here’s what property owners and businesses can anticipate:

Rapid upgrades to charging speeds as new vehicles and charging standards roll out

Integration of charging stations with solar, battery storage, and microgrid systems

Increased use of advanced software to optimize demand and energy costs

Potential for new revenue streams, such as charging-as-a-service or public access stations

Ongoing improvements in hardware durability, safety features, and user accessibility

Los Angeles is poised to be a leader thanks to strong infrastructure investments, world-class incentives, and a tech-savvy customer base.

Choosing an Installation Expert

The success of your EV charging project hinges on professional planning, code-compliant installation, and knowledgeable support. As a fully licensed Electrical and General Contractor, Shaffer Construction, Inc. provides expert turnkey EV charging solutions:

Site evaluation and electrical load analysis

System design for current and future expansion

Experienced installation teams with in-depth technical know-how

Solar integration expertise

Ongoing support, troubleshooting, and guidance on best practices

We coordinate all permitting, manage electrical upgrades, and ensure your system operates safely and efficiently from day one.

Conclusion

As EV technology rapidly advances, installing modern charging infrastructure offers significant benefits for Los Angeles property owners, businesses, and communities. With the market for EV charging stations ballooning and fast-evolving innovations—such as solar-integrated charging and near-instant recharge speeds—the opportunity to add value and support a cleaner environment has never been greater.
